comments.value: This doesn't seem to happen on every avatar. Perhaps you have a unique avatar animator setup? Could you provide details on that, such as any avatar animator prefabs like GogoLoco, or custom work you've done? Additionally, could you provide the avatar ID?

@{60285ca04963ba22994f485b|full_name}: Ha, so it looks like every avatar I tested was a variation of one avatar uploaded after a certain edit... yep! This one's on me. Feeling super smart. This post definitely doesn't need to be here, thanks for the amazingly fast looking out!

edit: OK, so I wanted to be 100% sure I know what's going on before I followed up, but I think it might have been every version of that avatar, and I think I know why but I can't test til my stuff's done charging. The avatar is INABA, and her gesture layer turns off tracking for each hand animation. While I don't spend a lot of time in gesture layers typically, I don't recall seeing that on every gesture on anything I use, just ones like peace where an animation will be subbed in since you can't get the correct pose from tracking alone. It stands to reason that this sort of thing is why when the gestures lock, the animation would hold... I'm just not sure why it never happened until now? Anyway, I'm just kinda guessing but I should be able to check in a few.

@{60285ca04963ba22994f485b|full_name}: Yep! The edit I made to my previous comment, that's it. I uploaded one completely stock version of the avatar I was having these issues on, and the same prefab with only the gesture layer disabled, and everything's working as normal. I tested this with another avatar that I knew had a special hand animation (ikshop's Kilsy is one of the ones I was referring to with the peace animation) and yeah, the same thing happens if you lock the gestures while you're doing that one. The other hand's fine, the face stays locked, but so does that hand.

Gonna update the original post accordingly. No clue if that's the intended behavior, but that seems to be what's going on and for whatever reason it never became an issue til the last update for me? It's possible I just... somehow never locked the gestures on any of those INABA edits, but that seems unlikely considering how often I do it, but I have no way of testing to see if that was the case. I think I might be more unsure than I was going in now, hah.

Thank you for reporting this issue. However, since the post is quite old and hasn't been updated recently, we encourage you to create a new ticket if the problem still persists.

details:
After the 2023.2.1p2 update my Index controllers will no longer allow for individual finger movement on the hand that toggles gestures off. I have clicking either stick set to toggle gestures, I've tried it on the radial menu on each hand, and when I toggle it in the main settings menu itself, both hands lock. The expression itself locks as it's supposed to, but the rest is kind of an issue for the way I've been using it.

I didn't think this was intended behavior, but I didn't see anyone mention it yet. Was it supposed to be this way?

edit: figured part of it out. The avatar's gesture layer turns off hand tracking and subs in its own animations for every hand gesture, which is not something many (if any) of my others have done for every gesture. Disabling the gesture layer in the avatar descriptor stops the issue completely, and this behavior can be reproduced on avatars who even do this with one gesture, with that particular gesture. I'm... just still not sure if somehow it's always been this way and I only just encountered this now somehow (?!), or if something really did change...
title: Gesture toggle locks hand that activates it
